job.title: WHS Advisor
job.description:
Our client is a national civil construction and road maintenance contractor, delivering projects for government and private clients across multiple states.

About the role
As HSE Advisor, you’ll be out on site, helping delivery teams work safely and well. You’ll monitor, coach and mentor operations staff in line with the company’s Safety, Environment and Quality Management System, and help drive continuous improvement in your state. You’ll report to the HSEQ Operations Manager.

Key responsibilities

  • Attend work sites to inspect, monitor, train and mentor delivery teams, championing a proactive safety culture
  • Ensure projects meet ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 requirements
  • Lead the development and review of SWMS and Safe Operating Procedures for high-risk work
  • Investigate workplace incidents and make sure corrective actions are closed out
  • Prequalify and monitor subcontractors so only compliant, ethical contractors start work
  • Report on HSE performance and respond promptly to regulators and client requirements

About you

  • Minimum 4 years’ HSE experience in asphalt or civil construction
  • Certificate IV in Occupational Health and Safety
  • Current WHS for Supervisors, Construction Induction, First Aid/CPR, Fire Warden training and a driver’s licence
  • Good knowledge of road maintenance construction methods
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to motivate both direct and subcontract labour
  • A calm, “can do” approach, strong attention to detail and the ability to work autonomously

Nice-to-haves

  • Environmental Awareness training
  • Experience coaching site teams in toolbox talks and risk identification

What we offer
Supportive, safety-first team that invests in your development and career progression.

Location & work arrangement
Melbourne northern suburbs, site-based with regular travel to project sites.

How to apply
For more information, please apply directly via the link with your resume. For additional inquiries, contact Jo Retallick at 0482 076 255
Thank you for your interest, we look forward to receiving your application!

job.title: Safety Operations Manager
job.description:
Join an Australian-owned civil infrastructure business that puts people at the centre of everything it does, and treats safety as one of the clearest expressions of that commitment.

About the role
You’ll be the primary operational safety voice to divisional managers and project leaders, the person they turn to when something happens, when something needs to change, and when they want to know how safety is tracking. Reporting to the Group Head of HSEQ, you’ll lead a team of 2 to 6 HSE Advisors and set the standard for how they work. This role has a genuine seat at the table.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead, coach and develop a team of HSE Advisors, setting clear expectations and managing performance
  • Run the inspection and audit programme across operational divisions, driving timely close-out of findings
  • Manage significant incidents end to end, from first response through root cause analysis to verified corrective action
  • Provide safety assurance over contractors and subcontractors working on site
  • Manage WorkSafe and other regulator interactions with transparency and professionalism
  • Coach supervisors and project managers to build safety leadership that lasts

About you

  • Tertiary qualification in OHS, or equivalent senior operational safety experience
  • Operational safety experience in construction, civil infrastructure, road maintenance or a comparable high-hazard industry
  • Experience leading or supervising safety professionals
  • Experience running incident investigations using a structured root cause methodology
  • Sound working knowledge of WHS legislation
  • Current Australian drivers licence and Construction Induction (White Card)

Nice-to-haves

  • Certificate IV in Training and Assessment
  • Familiarity with ISO 45001, 14001 or 9001, and OFSC accreditation
  • Experience with safety management software such as Donesafe
  • Background in civil infrastructure

What we offer
You’ll join a values-led culture where safety leaders are listened to, and where your team’s development and wellbeing matter.

Location & work arrangement
Based in northern suburbs of Melbourne with a hybrid mix of office and operational site attendance. Occasional interstate travel may be required.

How to apply

job.title: HSE Business Partner - Permanent
job.description:
Our client is a well-established Australian manufacturer and supplier to the construction industry. They have manufacturing and distribution sites across Queensland and New South Wales and are known for quality products and long-standing customer relationships. They're investing in growth, including a brand-new facility.

Reporting to the HSE Supervisor, you'll work closely with branch managers as a practical, trusted partner. This is a doing role, not a desk-bound strategic one. You'll be on the floor in high-vis, getting to know the teams and helping solve problems together. The sites are high-risk manufacturing and distribution environments with heavy machinery, overhead cranes, hoists and heavy vehicle movements.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop plant risk assessments, HSE documentation and traffic management plans
  • Prepare emergency response plans and establish the Emergency Control Organisation (ECO)
  • Oversee fire safety systems and requirements
  • Manage contractors through plant installation, commissioning and site fit-out
  • Visit each site on a regular schedule, with remote support in between
  • Carry out safety walks, task observations and internal audits
  • Guide and coach branch managers on all things HSE
  • Manage contractor safety, including delivery drivers and regular service providers
  • Coordinate drug and alcohol screening
  • Coordinate return-to-work programs
  • Support the training team and on-site training needs
  • Prepare your own risk assessments, procedures and reports

What you'll need:

  • Cert IV in Work Health and Safety
  • Proven hands-on HSE experience in heavy or process manufacturing and/or construction
  • The ability to hit the ground running and work autonomously, including setting up a new site
  • Advanced Microsoft 365 skills
  • A current driver's licence and willingness to travel regularly between sites
  • Knowledge of transport and logistics safety, including chain of responsibility and load restraint
  • Return-to-work coordinator experience
  • Trainer and assessor qualification

To be considered for this role please 'apply' by submitting an up to date word version of your CV. For more information please contact Matt at matthew.owen@zenergygroup.com.au

job.title: Safety Officer

job.title: Group Health & Safety Manager ANZ
job.description:

Shape how the organisation manages critical safety risks across Australia and New Zealand. Work directly with senior leaders and a collabarative ELT in a growing organisation. Offer strong, competitive remuneration.

job.title: WHS Consultant - 6 Month contract
job.description:
Our client, a leading global organisation, is looking for a Health and Safety Coordinator to join its site safety team on a 6-month contract. The site is a large, fast-paced logistics and warehousing operation with a large workforce working across multiple shifts.

You'll work closely with operations leaders, team members and the wider safety team. Your job is to keep people safe, keep the site compliant and build a strong safety culture on the floor. This hands-on role suits someone who enjoys being out on site rather than behind a desk.

Key responsibilities:

  • Support the day-to-day running of the site's Work Health and Safety (WHS) management system
  • Carry out regular workplace inspections, safety walks and audits, and follow through on corrective actions
  • Lead or support incident investigations, including root cause analysis, and track actions to close-out
  • Complete and review risk assessments, JSAs/SWMS and hazard registers
  • Manage key operational risks, including manual handling, mobile plant and forklifts, traffic management, conveyors and racking
  • Deliver safety inductions, toolbox talks and training sessions for team members and contractors
  • Support injury management and return-to-work programs together with HR and injury management providers
  • Coordinate contractor safety, including permits to work and site access
  • Plan and run emergency preparedness activities, such as evacuation drills and first aid coverage
  • Maintain safety records and report on lead and lag indicators
  • Support Health and Safety Representatives (HSRs) and the site safety committee
  • Keep the site compliant with the WHS Act, WHS Regulations and relevant Codes of Practice
  • Coach and influence leaders and team members to build a proactive safety culture

About you:

  • Certificate IV in Work Health and Safety (minimum)
  • At least 3 years' experience in a WHS role in warehousing, logistics, distribution, manufacturing or a similar high-volume operational environment
  • Working knowledge of WHS legislation, regulations and Codes of Practice
  • Hands-on experience running incident investigations, risk assessments and workplace inspections
  • Strong communication skills and the confidence to influence people at every level, from team members to senior leaders
  • Good organisational skills, with the ability to manage several priorities in a fast-moving environment
  • Confident using Microsoft Office and incident or safety management systems
  • Comfortable working on the floor in a physically active environment, including walking long distances
  • Flexibility to support different shifts when needed

To be considered for this role please 'apply' by submitting an up to date word version of your CV. For more information please reach out to Matt at matthew.owen@zenergygroup.com.au

job.title: General Manager Health and Safety
job.description:
General Manager Health and Safety
Our client is a 100% Australian-owned, national technical and facilities services provider. With branches in every state and territory, they deliver essential maintenance and services across commercial, government, healthcare, education, mining and marine sectors.

About the role
You’ll lead health and safety across a dispersed, high-risk, field-based workforce, reporting to the COO. This is a new chapter for the function. The business is growing through acquisition, the safety agenda is being elevated, and you’ll have real freedom to shape what it looks like. You’ll take have seat at the table in the General Manager group and be a trusted partner to the Executive Leadership Team.

Key responsibilities

  • Spend around half your time in the field, travelling across multiple regions to see the true status of safety first-hand
  • Set and drive HSE strategy, targets and accountability, working with state-based General Managers to build genuine safety ownership
  • Introduce and embed a new management cycle where safety metrics are presented and owned by operational leaders
  • Challenge the frontline and bring safety to life, moving the business from compliance to commitment
  • Integrate safety culture as new companies join the group, demonstrating measurable improvement
  • Lead and develop a small HSE team, with scope to grow it as the business needs

About you
You will hold Senior HSE leadership experience in a multi-site, high-risk environment such as facilities management, maintenance, construction, utilities or technical service, with proven success leading change and safety culture transformation.

In addition you will display:

  • Strong working knowledge of Australian WHS legislation and officer due-diligence obligations
  • Presence and credibility, with the ability to engage everyone from technicians to executives (a little humour helps)
  • A strategic mindset, comfortable pivoting in a dynamic, agile environment
  • Relevant HSE tertiary qualifications and a current driver’s licence

What we offer

  • Salary of $300,000 to $330,000 plus short-term incentive
  • A visible, influential executive-level role with the full support of the leadership team
  • A direct, transparent and accountable leadership culture, led by a COO who is new to the business and building a team that is honest and takes ownership
  • The chance to design the function from the ground up

How to apply
For more information, please apply directly via the link with your resume. For additional inquiries, contact Jo Retallick at 0482 076 255

Thank you for your interest, we look forward to receiving your application!

job.title: HSE Advisor - permanent

Our client is seeking a hands-on HSE Advisor to lead health, safety and environmental performance at their manufacturing site. You'll spend most of your time on the floor, partnering with production and maintenance teams to manage high-risk work and build a strong safety culture.

Our client is a global, technology-driven business with an open, collaborative and inclusive culture. Teamwork comes first, people are trusted to own their work, and there is a genuine focus on safety, wellbeing and continuous improvement. Ongoing learning and development is actively encouraged.   • Lead risk assessments for plant, machinery, guarding, traffic management and change

job.title: Health and Safety Advisor
job.description:
Zenergy is partnering with a leading infrastructure contractor to recruit Health and Safety Advisors for a major renewable energy and infrastructure project in regional NSW.

These are permanent positions offering competitive remuneration, attractive FIFO/DIDO arrangements and long-term career opportunities across future major infrastructure projects.

About the Role

Reporting to the Health and Safety Manager, you will provide hands-on safety support across a large-scale construction environment, working closely with project management, supervisors, subcontractors and frontline personnel.

You will support safety performance through site inspections, incident investigations, risk assessments, training and ongoing assurance activities, while promoting a positive and proactive safety culture.

These positions will suit practical, approachable safety professionals who enjoy being visible on site, building strong relationships and contributing to the safe delivery of complex construction projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide visible, hands-on safety support across construction teams and high-risk site activities.
  • Build strong relationships with project managers, supervisors, subcontractors and frontline personnel to promote a positive safety culture.
  • Conduct incident investigations, risk assessments and corrective action management.
  • Undertake workplace inspections, audits, safety observations and critical control verifications.
  • Review and support the implementation of SWMS, permits and safe systems of work.
  • Develop and deliver toolbox talks, inductions, pre-start meetings and safety communications.
  • Support the maintenance and continuous improvement of project safety management systems and procedures.
  • Monitor contractor compliance with WHS legislation, project requirements and relevant safety standards.
  • Work collaboratively with construction teams to identify operational risks and implement practical safety solutions.

About You

  • Certificate IV, Diploma or tertiary qualification in Work Health and Safety or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated experience in a Health and Safety Advisor, HSE Advisor, Safety Coordinator or similar position.
  • Ideally 3+ years of relevant experience
  • Experience across civil construction, major infrastructure, utilities, renewable energy, transmission, substations or electrical construction highly regarded.
  • Practical knowledge of high-risk construction activities, incident investigations, risk assessments and contractor management.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to build relationships across diverse project teams.
  • A hands-on, approachable attitude and willingness to learn and develop within a supportive safety team.
  • Previous experience working on regional projects, FIFO/DIDO rosters or remote construction sites advantageous.
  • A trades or operational construction background would be highly regarded.

  • Permanent employment with a leading international infrastructure contractor.

  • Accommodation and meals provided in a modern, purpose-built camp with excellent recreational facilities.
  • Transport arrangements and on-site vehicle provided.
  • Opportunity to work on a nationally significant renewable energy and infrastructure development.
  • Supportive and experienced safety leadership team, with opportunities for mentoring and professional development.
  • Long-term career opportunities with potential to transition onto future major infrastructure projects.

Next Steps

Apply with your current CV. Applications are reviewed as received.
